ASK-1.name: NO_SUCH_ACTION
ASK-1.description: Raised where no action goes by the name that was asked for.

ASK-10.name: WRONG_METHOD
ASK-10.description: Raised where an endpoint was asked with a method it does not answer.

ASK-11.name: NOT_A_KEY_REQUEST
ASK-11.description: Raised where the body of a mint is not a key's name, scope, purpose and the password, or the body of a collection is not a claim alone.

ASK-12.name: NOT_AN_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY
ASK-12.description: Raised where an action's `Idempotency-Key` is not one to 255 visible characters, or is given more than once.

ASK-13.name: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED
ASK-13.description: Raised where an `Idempotency-Key` already sent with one action and its arguments is sent with another.

ASK-2.name: MISSING_ARGUMENT
ASK-2.description: Raised where an action was not given an argument it needs.

ASK-3.name: UNRECOGNISED_ARGUMENT
ASK-3.description: Raised where an argument was given a value that names nothing.

ASK-4.name: UNWANTED_ARGUMENT
ASK-4.description: Raised where an action was given an argument its command has nowhere to put.

ASK-5.name: ARGUMENTS_TOGETHER
ASK-5.description: Raised where two arguments that each name a different request arrived together.

ASK-6.name: NOT_ARGUMENTS
ASK-6.description: Raised where the body of an action is not arguments it can read.

ASK-7.name: NO_SUCH_JOB
ASK-7.description: Raised where a job was asked about that this run did not start.

ASK-8.name: NOT_AN_ANSWER
ASK-8.description: Raised where the body of a setup step is not an answer it can read.

ASK-9.name: NO_ENDPOINT
ASK-9.description: Raised where a path under the endpoints is one no endpoint answers.
